_doc: The Rogue's den (docs/gdd/04d_otras_clases.md 4.22.6, O2 a: the thief), 3x3 with housing. forger_bench: laundering (Rogue.order_launder: one marked piece clean every launder.minutes, faster with the Production branch); fence: the den's own fence (Rogue.order_fence, any hour; the town's daily cap). Its tree (data/upgrades/den): Commerce pays the fence better (fence_bonus), Quality opens locks (lock_bonus), Security keeps other thieves out. upkeep 10 [balance].
